cruise.wish: Take a cruise trip with my mom and dad — the three of us at the ship railing, ocean wind in our faces.
cruise.svg:
<svg viewBox="0 0 400 220" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg">
  <style>
    @keyframes wave { from { transform: translateX(0); } to { transform: translateX(-32px); } }
    @keyframes float { 0%, 100% { transform: translateY(0); } 50% { transform: translateY(-9px); } }
  </style>
  <g fill="none" stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round">
    <!-- Far Background: Horizon and distant birds -->
    <g stroke="#B5A8D0" stroke-width="1.3" opacity="0.6">
      <path d="M 30 155 Q 200 155 370 155" /> <!-- Horizon line -->
      <path d="M 310 50 Q 315 45 320 50 M 320 50 Q 325 45 330 50" /> <!-- Bird 1 -->
      <path d="M 335 65 Q 338 62 341 65 M 341 65 Q 344 62 347 65" /> <!-- Bird 2 -->
    </g>

    <!-- Midground: The Ship (The Defining Prop) -->
    <g stroke="#6B5C8E" stroke-width="1.8">
      <!-- Hull -->
      <path d="M 60 155 L 340 155 C 360 155 370 140 365 120 L 350 80 L 100 80 C 80 80 60 100 60 155 Z" />
      <!-- Upper Deck Layers -->
      <path d="M 110 80 L 110 60 L 330 60 L 342 80" />
      <path d="M 140 60 L 140 45 L 280 45 L 290 60" />
      <!-- Funnel and Smoke -->
      <path d="M 170 45 L 170 30 L 195 30 L 195 45" />
      <path d="M 182 25 Q 195 10 210 15" style="animation: float 4s ease-in-out infinite" /> <!-- Smoke curl -->
      <!-- Porthole dots -->
      <circle cx="100" cy="110" r="2.5" fill="#6B5C8E" />
      <circle cx="140" cy="110" r="2.5" fill="#6B5C8E" />
      <circle cx="180" cy="110" r="2.5" fill="#6B5C8E" />
      <circle cx="220" cy="110" r="2.5" fill="#6B5C8E" />
    </g>

    <!-- Hero: The Three Figures at the Railing -->
    <g stroke="#2E2B33" stroke-width="2.6">
      <!-- Railing line -->
      <path d="M 115 72 L 325 72" />
      
      <!-- Mom (Left) -->
      <path d="M 185 72 Q 183 55 186 48" /> <!-- Torso -->
      <ellipse cx="188" cy="42" rx="6" ry="7" /> <!-- Head -->
      <path d="M 182 40 Q 175 42 178 48" /> <!-- Hair hint -->
      <path d="M 185 58 Q 175 65 178 72" /> <!-- Arm on rail -->

      <!-- User (Center) -->
      <path d="M 210 72 Q 212 52 210 45" /> <!-- Torso -->
      <ellipse cx="210" cy="38" rx="6" ry="7" /> <!-- Head -->
      <path d="M 210 55 Q 220 58 225 72" /> <!-- Arm -->

      <!-- Dad (Right) -->
      <path d="M 235 72 Q 238 55 235 48" /> <!-- Torso -->
      <ellipse cx="236" cy="42" rx="6" ry="7" /> <!-- Head -->
      <path d="M 235 58 Q 245 60 248 72" /> <!-- Arm -->
    </g>

    <!-- Foreground: Waves and Texture -->
    <g stroke="#2E2B33" stroke-width="2.2">
      <path d="M 40 175 Q 80 165 120 175 Q 160 185 200 175 Q 240 165 280 175 Q 320 185 360 175" 
            stroke-dasharray="16 10" style="animation: wave 3s linear infinite" />
      <path d="M 20 195 Q 70 185 120 195 Q 170 205 220 195 Q 270 185 320 195 Q 370 205 420 195" 
            stroke-dasharray="20 12" opacity="0.5" style="animation: wave 6s linear infinite" />
    </g>
    
    <!-- Sparse Texture Hatching -->
    <g stroke="#B5A8D0" stroke-width="1.3" opacity="0.4">
      <path d="M 150 162 L 160 162 M 152 166 L 162 166" /> <!-- Water tick -->
      <path d="M 280 162 L 290 162 M 282 166 L 292 166" /> <!-- Water tick -->
    </g>
  </g>
</svg>

van.wish: Convert a campervan and drive it around the whole country, waking up somewhere new.
van.svg:
<svg viewBox="0 0 400 220" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg">
  <style>
    @keyframes float { 0%, 100% { transform: translateY(0); } 50% { transform: translateY(-9px); } }
    @keyframes breeze { 0%, 100% { transform: translateX(0); } 50% { transform: translateX(12px); } }
  </style>
  <g fill="none" stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round">
    <!-- Far Background: Distant Mountains and Sun -->
    <g stroke="#B5A8D0" stroke-width="1.3" opacity="0.7">
      <path d="M40,165 C100,140 160,165 220,145 C280,125 330,155 370,165" />
      <circle cx="310" cy="70" r="12" /> <!-- Low Sun -->
      <!-- Floating Clouds -->
      <g style="animation: float 6s ease-in-out infinite">
        <path d="M70,60 C85,55 95,65 110,60" />
        <path d="M240,45 C250,40 260,50 275,45" />
      </g>
    </g>

    <!-- Midground: Ground Line and Path -->
    <g stroke="#6B5C8E" stroke-width="1.8">
      <path d="M30,185 L370,185" /> <!-- Horizon/Ground line -->
      <path d="M30,195 C100,190 180,210 250,195" opacity="0.5" /> <!-- Winding path edge -->
      <!-- Small Tree -->
      <path d="M330,185 L330,160 M330,170 L320,165 M330,175 L340,170" />
    </g>

    <!-- Hero: The Campervan (The Defining Prop) -->
    <g stroke="#2E2B33" stroke-width="2.6">
      <!-- Van Body: Recognizable Silhouette -->
      <path d="M140,185 L260,185 L260,130 C260,120 250,115 240,115 L155,115 C145,115 140,120 140,130 Z" />
      <!-- Windows and Door -->
      <path d="M150,125 L180,125 L180,145 L150,145 Z" /> <!-- Front window -->
      <path d="M195,125 L245,125 L245,145 L195,145 Z" /> <!-- Side window -->
      <circle cx="165" cy="185" r="3" fill="#2E2B33" /> <!-- Wheel 1 -->
      <circle cx="235" cy="185" r="3" fill="#2E2B33" /> <!-- Wheel 2 -->
      
      <!-- The Person: Small gesture figure leaning against the van -->
      <g transform="translate(275, 185)">
        <path d="M0,0 C-2,-15 -5,-25 -2,-35" /> <!-- Spine/Torso -->
        <ellipse cx="-1" cy="-42" rx="5" ry="7" /> <!-- Tilted head -->
        <path d="M-2,-30 C-8,-25 -12,-15 -10,-5" /> <!-- Arm leaning -->
        <path d="M-1,-15 C2,-10 5,0 4,0" /> <!-- Leg weight -->
      </g>

      <!-- Smoke/Steam from a small roof vent (Motion) -->
      <g style="animation: float 4s ease-in-out infinite">
        <path d="M210,110 C212,100 208,95 210,85" stroke-width="1.5" opacity="0.6" />
      </g>
    </g>

    <!-- Texture and Details -->
    <g stroke="#B5A8D0" stroke-width="1.3" opacity="0.6">
      <!-- Grass ticks -->
      <path d="M50,185 L52,180 M80,188 L82,183 M350,185 L352,180" />
      <!-- Shadow hatch under van -->
      <path d="M160,192 L180,192 M220,192 L240,192" />
      <!-- Breeze lines (Motion) -->
      <g style="animation: breeze 7s ease-in-out infinite">
        <path d="M300,100 Q310,95 320,100" />
        <path d="M40,120 Q50,115 60,120" />
      </g>
    </g>
  </g>
</svg>
